components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Indigo action button; the single most saturated element on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 12px 16px; background: #4f46e5; color: #ffffff; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(99,102,241,0.35); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4338ca; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(79,70,229,0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Neutral bordered action for secondary affordances.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 12px 16px; background: #ffffff; color: #0f172a; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #f8fafc; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(79,70,229,0.3); }

components.name: Ghost Icon Button
components.description: Icon-only action (logout, dialog close); low emphasis.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost" aria-label="Close"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"/><line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; background: transparent; color: #64748b; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f1f5f9; color: #334155; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(79,70,229,0.3); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard financial form field with indigo focus ring and rose error state.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; background: #ffffff; color: #0f172a; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 10px; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #64748b; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #6366f1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(99,102,241,0.2); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Card
components.description: White bordered surface; flat at rest, lifts subtly on hover.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 14px; padding: 24px; color: #0f172a; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; transition: box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .ds-card-title { font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #1e293b; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #334155; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Pill status chip encoding gain/loss/warning; never decorative.
components.css: .ds-badge-gain { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 10px; background: #ecfdf5; color: #059669; border: 1px solid #d1fae5; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-badge-loss { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 10px; background: #fff1f2; color: #e11d48; border: 1px solid #ffe4e6; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Indigo-tinted active nav row against a white rail.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; width: 240px; padding: 16px; background: #ffffff; border-right: 1px solid #e2e8f0; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 14px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #64748b; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #f8fafc; color: #334155; } .ds-nav-active { background: #eef2ff; color: #4338ca; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); }

components.name: Investment Vault Hero
components.description: Signature dark gradient panel; the product's premium/owned-money surface.
components.css: .ds-vault { position: relative; overflow: hidden; padding: 24px; border-radius: 18px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f172a 0%, #1e1b4b 50%, #0f172a 100%); border: 1px solid rgba(55,48,163,0.4); box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(30,27,75,0.2); color: #ffffff; } .ds-vault-kicker { display: block; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #a5b4fc; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-vault-value { display: block; font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; font-size: 30px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.025em; }

narrative.overview: FinTrack's visual identity is a dense, high-contrast financial workspace with a single indigo voice: a light slate canvas, crisp white surfaces, 1px boundaries, and one saturated accent that marks where the user acts and where money is brand-owned. It is built for Indonesian individuals and freelancers who scan numbers all day, so readability of tabular data outranks decoration. The system rejects warm SaaS-cream neutrals and ambient-shadow card stacks; depth comes from borders and contrast, and shadows are reserved for state. The identity is deliberately dual-material: the operational surface (dashboard, transactions, statements, receipts) is light, flat, and neutral with indigo carried only by the active nav item, the primary action, and brand marks; the vault surface (login, investment hero) flips to a deep slate-to-indigo gradient to signal a premium protected space. Because the product displays money, color is meaningful: emerald reads as gain, rose as loss, amber as caution, and indigo as neutral brand action.
keyCharacteristics: Single indigo accent (#4f46e5 / indigo-600) on a slate canvas; indigo never exceeds ~10% of an operational screen.
Poppins for headings and brand; Inter for all numbers, tables, and body copy.
Flat-by-default with 1px borders (slate-200) as the primary depth cue.
Semantic money color: emerald (positive), rose (negative), amber (warning).
One radius ladder driven by the shadcn --radius token (10px base, scaling to 18-24px surfaces).
Immediate in-page skeleton feedback instead of blocking spinners.

rules.name: The One Indigo Voice Rule
rules.body: Indigo (#4f46e5) is the only saturated brand color and appears on <=10% of any operational screen: the primary action, the active nav item, and brand marks. Everything else is slate, white, or a semantic status color. Its rarity is what makes it read as the thing to click.

rules.name: The Money-Is-Not-Decoration Rule
rules.body: Emerald, rose, and amber exist only to encode financial state (gain/loss/warning). They never appear as arbitrary fills, backgrounds, or accent flourishes.

rules.name: The Numbers-Are-Inter Rule
rules.body: Every monetary value, percentage, and tabular cell uses Inter (and font-mono for aligned figures where columns must line up). Poppins is forbidden in any numeric context.

rules.name: The Poppins-Headings Rule
rules.body: All page and card headings opt in explicitly with the font-poppins (or font-heading) utility; body text inherits Inter from <html> and never needs a font class.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow is only legitimate as a response to state (hover, focus, overlay, elevation), never as a resting decoration on a standard card.

rules.name: The No-Ghost-Card Rule
rules.body: A resting card never combines a 1px border with a large blurred shadow. Boundary or float - not both.

rules.name: The Ladder Rule
rules.body: Radius is never hand-picked per component. It is chosen from the --radius-derived ladder (lg / xl / 2xl / 3xl) so every surface stays in one family.

rules.name: The Capsule Exception
rules.body: rounded-full is permitted only on badges, status chips, and circular avatars/icons; it is never used for buttons, cards, or inputs.

dos: Do format all currency via Intl.NumberFormat('id-ID') with the rupiah symbol and correct thousands separators.
Do set every page/card heading in Poppins (font-poppins/font-heading) and leave body/numeric text in Inter.
Do build depth from a 1px slate-200 border on a slate-50 canvas; add a shadow only for hover, focus, or overlay.
Do keep indigo to <=10% of an operational screen: primary action + active nav + brand mark.
Do pick radii from the --radius ladder (rounded-lg to 3xl), not ad hoc values.
Do ship a layout-matching animate-pulse skeleton for every async route, and honor reduced-motion.
Do use emerald/rose/amber strictly to encode gain, loss, and warning.
donts: Don't use warm neutral/beige SaaS-cream backgrounds; the neutral ramp is cool slate.
Don't apply a large blurred shadow to a resting bordered card (no ghost cards).
Don't use the #4f46e5 hex directly - emit it through the token (indigo-600) so dark-mode and theming stay viable.
Don't set numbers or table cells in Poppins, and don't set the brand in Inter.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text) for headings.
Don't round buttons, cards, or inputs to full pills; pills are for badges and status chips only.
Don't use saturated status colors as decorative fills or backgrounds.
Don't let table text overflow its cell; use truncation with a tooltip for long values.
Don't replace in-page skeletons with a blocking full-screen spinner.
